== English errata comparison sources ==
Decipher changes any warrior to your warrior and specifies a character or creature and defense value. The Dark host retains its own artwork and lore even where the gameplay words match the Light host. The adjacent formula on the PC strip is for Dark Jedi Lightsaber.
